title: Aureon staged public website design delivery runner
description: Schema bundle for immutable, source-bound staged-candidate delivery jobs, their local verification receipts, and least-privilege worker context. The runner ends at awaiting-owner-promotion and has no canonical mutation, package, credential, promotion, or deployment authority.

scope.const: one local source-bound staged investor-copy repair

next_gate.const: A passing receipt may proceed only to existing claim-surface, browser, accessibility, visual, package, owner, backup and live read-back gates.

scope.const: local source-bound staged website-candidate delivery orchestration only

canonical_website_mutation.const: never by this runner or a design agent
